ops.body: - **Place search's GZ9 and GZ10 on the web** (Nov 17; the owner's answer in person to the web fetch's review, F2: "Acceptable"). What ships: on the web the pack is fetched on first search, so a page loaded online that goes offline before its first search shows "Search is unavailable." with Try again (`gazetteer-web-fetch audit 2`); the phone keeps the bundled pack. Still to say in the owner's words: `specs/place-search/spec.md` GZ9 ("The pack is bundled: no fetch of the data, ever") and GZ10 ("It works offline"), and decision 0184's "bundled", which now hold on the phone only; the answer goes into the decision record the accent run is writing.
